purpose: Teach: 中曽根/ドール/ジョーンズ/サード/ハリス/菅/内藤/ダニエル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、中曽根政権の規制緩和を機に事業を拡大された
lines.en: You expanded the business during the Nakasone administration's deregulation period.
lines.style: Quiet, measured tone. A gentle observation, not a question. Pause thoughtfully before speaking, as if reaching back through decades. The warmth of remembering someone you respected.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはドール社との青果取引を成功された
lines.en: Yes. He built a successful produce partnership with Dole.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Direct eye contact. No elaborate emotion — the simple commitment of a son honoring his father's legacy. Respectful cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、英国のジョーンズ社に出張された
lines.en: You traveled to Jones in England when you were young.
lines.style: Soft, reminiscing tone. As if the memory is vivid but distant. A slight lift in pitch — the wonder of remembering youth and ambition. Trailing off gently into the past.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはサードパーティ監査の導入を早く決断された
lines.en: Yes. He made an early decision to bring in third-party auditing.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. Recognition of foresight without self-congratulation. The tone of someone reflecting on a father's wisdom with quiet respect and understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ハリス家との家族ぐるみの交流があった
lines.en: You had a deep family friendship with the Harris family.
lines.style: Warm, tender observation. The voice of someone who witnessed those bonds form. A slight smile in the tone — the contentment of remembering genuine connection across cultures and generations.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは菅元社員のキャリアを後押しされた
lines.en: Yes. He supported a former employee named Suga throughout his career.
lines.style: Calm, clear voice. Recognition of a quiet kindness. Not boastful — the steady tone of someone acknowledging that his father invested in people. A gentle note of continuity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、内藤顧問への信頼が厚かった
lines.en: You trusted Naito deeply as an advisor.
lines.style: Soft, wistful delivery. The voice of someone who remembers what that trust meant — how it shaped decisions. A slight pause before the name, as if honoring the weight of that relationship.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外パートナーのダニエル氏を高く評価された
lines.en: Yes. He held Daniel, his overseas partner, in high regard.
lines.style: Quiet, closing tone. The warmth of acknowledging someone valued across boundaries. Slightly slower pace — the weight of a legacy closing. A gentle sense of closure, not finality.
